author: makarasz
quote:
Such a shame. I don't know why the critics review are good. The game us dull, not fun, boring even. Emotionally flat. Nothing exciting. The story is boring, too... Such a shame... It looks, feels and plays like a something that was designed by corporate HR, or by frustrated people who don't like games. Buy only when the price drops to less than £7. Not fun. Missed opportunity. 
Technically - not even that great either. Visuals are ok, but physics are disappointing...

author: makarasz
quote: Two is probably a stretch. the game is boring, packed with political agendas, hardly and choices, poor writing,awful characters, poor performance. But Baldur’s Gate 3 instead. This is a disaster; wait until it costs below $3.

author: makarasz
quote:
Very poor attention to details for a modern production; feels very 2005. Old engine. Lifeless world. Poor characters (NPCs). Impossible to remove pronouns. Way to woke for normal production - feels they had an agenda to push, rather than focusing on what matters in a game. You can choose which way paper roll hangs in the toilet - which raised my rating from 3 to 4 Play BG3 instead - this one is not worth a penny in 2023
Missed opportunity… shame.
